## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. [Method](../method.md)

## How to run it

### Through an API

api (Weights & Biases) · $0.11/M blended · $0.1 in / $0.15 out per 1M tokens · [wandb.ai](https://wandb.ai/site/pricing/tokens/)

<sub>[price source](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/blob/c19ce71bcdad234ca87a7af10cee45375ce811a8/model_prices_and_context_window.json): USD per 1M text tokens, standard uncached input and output.  Product: W&B Inference. API model: ibm-granite/granite-4.2-8b. Settings: service tier=standard, batch=no, cache=uncached input. Additional/excluded charges: Tools, cache storage, priority service and other modalities excluded.. Currency: USD. · [context source](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/blob/c19ce71bcdad234ca87a7af10cee45375ce811a8/model_prices_and_context_window.json): provider maximum input tokens; not an intrinsic model maximum or legacy max\_tokens</sub>

### llama.cpp (recommended)

1. Install llama.cpp. Homebrew and winget installs name the commands llama-cli and llama-server instead. [Other ways to install](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/docs/install.md)
   
   ```sh
   # macOS / Linux
   curl -LsSf https://llama.app/install.sh | sh
   # Windows
   irm https://llama.app/install.ps1 | iex
   ```

2. Run Granite 4.2 8B (Q4_K_M, needs 7.2 GB memory, 5.35 GB download, from [huggingface.co/ibm-granite](https://huggingface.co/ibm-granite/granite-4.2-8b-GGUF/tree/93f3f6a8938ee922b784cf4e5b4203cd3428df8f))
   
   ```sh
   llama cli -hf ibm-granite/granite-4.2-8b-GGUF:Q4_K_M
   ```

3. Or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
   
   ```sh
   llama serve -hf ibm-granite/granite-4.2-8b-GGUF:Q4_K_M
   ```

Other versions: Q8_0 (11.2 GB memory, 9.35 GB download) `llama cli -hf ibm-granite/granite-4.2-8b-GGUF:Q8_0`

### LM Studio

1. Install LM Studio. Open the app once before using the lms command. [Download it (macOS / Windows / Linux)](https://lmstudio.ai/download)

2. Run Granite 4.2 8B (Q4_K_M, needs 7.2 GB memory, 5.35 GB download, from [huggingface.co/ibm-granite](https://huggingface.co/ibm-granite/granite-4.2-8b-GGUF/tree/93f3f6a8938ee922b784cf4e5b4203cd3428df8f))
   
   ```sh
   lms get https://huggingface.co/ibm-granite/granite-4.2-8b-GGUF@Q4_K_M -y
   ```

3. Then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name

Other versions: Q8_0 (11.2 GB memory, 9.35 GB download) `lms get https://huggingface.co/ibm-granite/granite-4.2-8b-GGUF@Q8_0 -y` · 4bit (6.8 GB memory, 4.95 GB download, Mac only) `lms get https://huggingface.co/ibm-granite/granite-4.2-8b-q4-mlx -y` · 8bit (11.2 GB memory, 9.34 GB download, Mac only) `lms get https://huggingface.co/ibm-granite/granite-4.2-8b-q8-mlx -y`

### Ollama

1. Install Ollama. [Download it (macOS / Windows)](https://ollama.com/download)
   
   ```sh
   # Linux
   curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh
   ```

2. Run Granite 4.2 8B (Q4_K_M, needs 7.2 GB memory, 5.35 GB download, from [ollama.com](https://ollama.com/library/granite4.2/tags))
   
   ```sh
   ollama run granite4.2:8b
   ```

### MLX (Mac)

1. Install MLX (Mac). Apple silicon Macs only, text only.
   
   ```sh
   # with uv
   uv tool install mlx-lm
   # or
   pip install mlx-lm
   ```

2. Run Granite 4.2 8B (4bit, needs 6.8 GB memory, 4.95 GB download, Mac only, from [huggingface.co/ibm-granite](https://huggingface.co/ibm-granite/granite-4.2-8b-q4-mlx/tree/9047f073e46c527f70dade07bb55b1700d728e36))
   
   ```sh
   mlx_lm.chat --model ibm-granite/granite-4.2-8b-q4-mlx
   ```

3. Or start an OpenAI-compatible server at http://localhost:8080/v1
   
   ```sh
   mlx_lm.server --model ibm-granite/granite-4.2-8b-q4-mlx
   ```

Other versions: 8bit (11.2 GB memory, 9.34 GB download, Mac only) `mlx_lm.chat --model ibm-granite/granite-4.2-8b-q8-mlx`
